'''Port Evokk''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of con artist and gambler [[Tord Gamb]]. The locals of this [[Planet/Legends|planet]] would use [[ansmul-hide]] to make [[Boot/Legends|boots]] and jackets. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sirenas Firil]] worked with a small guild out of Port Evokk.<ref name="TPO">{{WEGCite|book=Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters|story=Two for the Price of One}}</ref>
